featured.title: Boris Cherny · Anthropic Claude Code 负责人
featured.summaryEn: Boris Cherny announced Claude Ship in beta for Team and Enterprise plans. A year after Opus 4.5 became the first model to write 100% of his code, shipping PRs still hadn't caught up. Claude Ship splits that last mile into Code Review (finds bugs), PR Steward (fixes issues and failing checks) and Claude Approvals (approves what team policy allows; the latter two in beta). His rollout advice: admins enable it per GitHub repo, start with one repo and run Approvals in observe mode until you trust it.
featured.insightZh: Boris Cherny 宣布 Claude Ship 面向 Team 和 Enterprise 计划开启 beta。他说一年前 Opus 4.5 已经能写他 100% 的代码，但「把 PR 发出去」这一环一直没跟上。Claude Ship 把这一环拆成三块：Code Review 找 bug，PR Steward 修复问题和失败的检查，Claude Approvals 按团队策略自动审批（后两者为 beta）。他的说法是「不用再等 code review、不用盯着 PR，结果还更好」。落地建议：管理员可按 GitHub 仓库开启，先从一个仓库开始，Approvals 先跑 observe 模式，建立信任后再放开。

Separately, zero data retention (ZDR) with Enterprise Frontier Safeguards (EFS) is in public beta: EFS detects misuse across many requests while staying ZDR-compatible, built with 100+ customers. It's available on Claude Platform, Claude Platform on AWS, Amazon B…
featured.insightZh: Claude 官方今天发了两条企业侧的重要更新。一是 Connectors 和 Skills 合并为统一的「Plugins」，连接工具和教会 Claude 新技能现在走同一个入口，已在 Free / Pro / Max / Ultra 上线，Team 和 Enterprise 即将支持，插件目录已超过 10,000 个。二是「零数据保留（ZDR）+ Enterprise Frontier Safeguards（EFS）」进入公开 beta：EFS 能跨多个请求识别滥用，同时兼容 ZDR，与 100 多家客户共同开发；目前在 Claude Platform、AWS 上的 Claude Platform、Amazon Bedrock、Google Cloud 上可用，Microsoft Foundry 支持即将推出。

items.title: Amjad Masad · Replit CEO
items.summaryEn: Amjad Masad shared new Replit research on scaling laws for agent swarms. In a fixed two-hour window, Opus 5.5 went from a 3.7x NumPy speedup with one agent to 18.9x with 32 agents, while GPT-6.2 Astra was the strongest solo agent but scaled negatively beyond 8. Decentralized swarms beat centrally coordinated ones, problem parallelizability strongly predicted performance, and individual model intelligence was a poor predictor of collective intelligence. Replit is open-sourcing Optimization-Bench. He also met VP JD…
items.insightZh: Amjad Masad 发布了 Replit 关于「Agent 集群扩展定律」的研究：在固定两小时内，Opus 5.5 在 NumPy 优化任务上从单 agent 3.7 倍加速提升到 32 个 agent 时的 18.9 倍；GPT-6.2 Astra 是最强的单兵 agent，但超过 8 个 agent 后出现负向扩展。模型会自发形成不同的组织结构，去中心化集群比依赖中心协调的扩展得更好；问题本身的可并行度是集群表现的强预测因子，而单个模型的智能水平反而不能很好预测集体智能。Replit 同时开源了 Optimization-Bench。另外他提到上周五与副总统 JD Vance 会面，讨论美国 AI 领导力、网络安全和开放权重模型——「美国可能赢下前沿 AI 竞赛，却输掉全球 AI 生态」，因为盟友想要主权 AI 并越来越多转向中国开源模型；他也对 Jensen 回到 Nvidia 表示欢迎。

items.title: Thibault Sottiaux · OpenAI Codex & ChatGPT
items.summaryEn: Thibault Sottiaux said ChatGPT users should feel a significant jump in answer quality once the rollout reaches them, and combined with simplifying the app, making it faster and merging chat & work, day-to-day experience should improve markedly by year-end. Inside OpenAI, dots are becoming the primary way to get things done — "we have dots building the dots system." He also recommended a conversation on OpenAI's work patching flaws in OSS software and infrastructure.
items.insightZh: Thibault Sottiaux 透露 ChatGPT 即将推送一次回答质量的明显跃升，叠加简化应用、提速、合并 chat 与 work 等投入，到年底日常体验会有很大改善。他还说在 OpenAI 内部，「dots」正迅速成为完成工作的主要方式——「我们用 dots 来构建 dots 系统」。另外推荐了一期关于 OpenAI 团队如何修补开源软件和基础设施漏洞的访谈。

items.title: Peter Yang · AI 教程创作者
items.summaryEn: In contrast to the internal enthusiasm, Peter Yang said ChatGPT Dots still feels very buggy — it sent emails without his review and randomly stops responding. He wants to like the product but wonders if he's prompting it wrong.
items.insightZh: 与 OpenAI 内部的乐观形成对照，Peter Yang 吐槽 ChatGPT Dots 目前仍然很 buggy：会在他没审核的情况下直接发出邮件，还会无故停止响应。他说很想喜欢这个产品，但怀疑是不是自己 prompt 写错了。

items.title: Aaron Levie · Box CEO
items.summaryEn: Aaron Levie argued services businesses have always been capped by headcount and finite talent. Agents change the calculus by decoupling output from time: one engineer can produce what dozens did before. The key is still having experts on the front end to ensure agents deliver the right outcomes. He expects this across cybersecurity, advertising, legal, accounting and IT transformation — a great time to start or transform such a business.
items.insightZh: Aaron Levie 认为服务业一直受限于交付能力，规模只能靠人头扩张，而人才总是有限的。Agent 彻底改变了这个算式：产出与投入时间脱钩，一个工程师能顶过去几十个，一个设计师能搭完整套设计系统和品牌。但关键仍是前端要有专家来确保 agent 交付正确结果。他预计网络安全、广告营销、法律、会计、IT 转型等传统「纯人力」服务行业都会出现这种模式——无论新创还是改造既有业务，现在都是好时机。

items.title: Guillermo Rauch · Vercel CEO
items.summaryEn: Guillermo Rauch had Fable study all his coding sessions to run a "personal eval" between Opus and Gemini Neon — it picked Neon. He thinks Google being "so, so back" is widely under-discussed. He also announced Vercel is doubling down on Japan.
items.insightZh: Guillermo Rauch 让 Fable 研究他所有的编码会话，做一次「个人评测」，判断 Opus 和 Gemini Neon 谁更适合他——结果选了 Neon。他认为 Google 的强势回归被严重低估。另外宣布 Vercel 加码日本市场。

items.title: Dan Shipper · Every CEO
items.summaryEn: Dan Shipper echoed the personal-eval theme: you need to be "personal benchmark maxxing," sharing a how-to from colleague @hammer_mt on building one.
items.insightZh: Dan Shipper 呼应「个人 benchmark」思路：你需要把个人 benchmark 做到极致，并分享了同事 @hammer_mt 写的如何构建个人 benchmark 的方法。

items.title: Madhu Guru · Meta AI 高级总监（前 Google Gemini/Veo/Nano Banana 负责人）
items.summaryEn: Madhu Guru argued the word "data" massively undersells its role in model development. Outsiders see it as an inert commodity shoveled into a model like coal, but great data encodes high-value knowledge, taste and expertise, often structured in ways that didn't exist before — making it a fundamental building block for increasingly capable intelligence.
items.insightZh: Madhu Guru 认为「数据」这个名字严重低估了它在模型开发中的价值。外行把数据当成像煤一样可以买来铲进模型的惰性商品，但优质数据其实编码了高价值的知识、品味和专业判断，且常以前所未有的方式被表述和结构化。它是跨领域构建更强智能的根本基石之一，并将持续处于智能产业的核心。

items.title: Thariq · 前 Anthropic Claude Code
items.summaryEn: Thariq said X payouts are a good model for future software companies: keep a lean core team and pay the users who help it grow, improve through feedback, and sell.
items.insightZh: Thariq 认为 X 的创作者分成是未来软件公司的好模型：保持精简的核心团队，向帮助产品增长、提供反馈改进、帮忙销售的用户付费。

items.title: Aditya Agarwal · South Park Commons GP、前 Dropbox CTO
items.summaryEn: Aditya Agarwal observed that good organizations that survive an existential crisis come back meaner and out for blood — he felt this repeatedly at Meta, and says Nvidia isn't going to hold back now. He also highlighted a proactive agent "you don't have to prompt," and reflected on how much ambitious people abroad aspire to America's entrepreneurial ecosystem.
items.insightZh: Aditya Agarwal 观察到，好的组织在经历未能摧毁它的生存危机后，往往会更狠、更有攻击性地回归——他在 Meta 反复感受到这一点，并判断 Nvidia 现在不会再收着打。他还转发了一款「无需 prompt、主动工作」的 agent 产品发布，并谈到出国后更能体会美国创业生态和资本市场对全球雄心勃勃者的吸引力。

items.title: Garry Tan · Y Combinator 总裁兼 CEO
items.summaryEn: Garry Tan offered a self-prompting loop for startups: keep asking "are we dying?" — asking is how you spot the thing killing you and avert it.
items.insightZh: Garry Tan 给创业公司一个「自我 prompt 循环」技巧：经常问自己「我们是不是在走向死亡？」——问了才可能发现正在杀死你的东西并及时规避。

items.title: Zara Zhang · Builder
items.summaryEn: Zara Zhang shared how to prevent AI slop in design without being a designer, and argued posting daily and staying private aren't contradictory: she shares less than 1% of her life — the slice that's both interesting to others and comfortable for her.
items.insightZh: Zara Zhang 分享了「不是设计师也能避免 AI 设计 slop」的方法；另外谈到每天发社交媒体和保持隐私并不矛盾——她只分享生活和想法的不到 1%，关键是找到「别人觉得有趣」与「自己愿意分享」的交集。
